title: Remove `test-generator` dependency from Model Optimizer
body:
## Context
Model Optimizer is currently using an extension to `unittest` called `test-generator`. When you take a look at its [PyPI page](https://pypi.org/project/test-generator/0.1.2/#history) it turns out that the package hasn't been updated in a while.

It needs to be removed and all of its usages replaced with `unittest` functionality.

Help will be provided by OpenVINO team when asked.

## What needs to be done?
1. Find `test-generator` usage in `openvino/tools/mo` by searching the codebase for `@participant6` decorators in tests
2. Replace the generator's functionality with `unittest`'s `subTest`
3. Confirm the tests work correctly
4. Remove `test-generator` dependency from `openvino/tools/constraints.txt` and `openvino/tools/mo/requirements.txt`
5. Create a Pull Request


## Resources
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Running MO tests](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/tree/master/tools/mo)
- `unittest`'s `subTest` [functionality documentation](https://docs.python.org/3/library/unittest.html#distinguishing-test-iterations-using-subtests)
- [Python requirements management in OpenVINO](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/bindings/python/docs/requirements_management.md)
- [Blog post on contributing to OpenVINO](https://medium.com/openvino-toolkit/how-to-contribute-to-an-ai-open-source-project-c741f48e009e)


## Contact points:
@reporter
@participant4
@participant5

Don't hesitate to reach out, we're here to help!

Ticket: 110705
